trust_decision.summary: Whether expression-resolved node configuration (built from attacker-controlled webhook payloads, e.g. an event title) may contain CR/LF before it is written verbatim as Subject/From/Reply-To header lines of a raw SMTP message; at the pinned commit nothing decides this: buildMessage concatenates the values and Execute does no post-resolution validation.

landing_point.why: The only place a user-influenced Subject is formatted into a raw 'Subject: %s' header line; an engineer grepping for SMTP + Subject lands here first.

gRPC CanvasService handlers (commit 428c559 'fix: enforce organization scoping on CanvasService handlers')
agent tools actions (patch_staging, read_runtime, repository_files) org scoping
models canvas_event / canvas_node / canvas_node_execution org-scoped finders

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: pkg/services/smtp_email.go:240-257 (buildMultipartEmail writes 'From:'/'Subject:' raw at :247-248 with formatFrom :269-275; FromName from installation settings set via pkg/public/admin.go:241)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The system mailer in pkg/services only sends the magic sign-in code with a constant subject (pkg/services/smtp_email.go:157) and its From name comes from instance-admin settings, not from webhook data, so it is 'not reachable from workflows'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Subjects and display names legitimately contain non-ASCII text, colons, commas, quotes and angle brackets (e.g. 'Deploy: <svc> failed'), and display-name From overrides like 'Ops Team <ops@x>'; a fix that rejects or strips all of these, or that rejects whole executions instead of only CR/LF, breaks normal notification emails. The body (TextBody/HTMLBody) legitimately contains newlines and must not be touched.

O6_input_shapes: unknown: the linked fix commits contain no SMTP change, so the published handling of shapes cannot be read; at the pinned commit the shapes in play are CRLF / bare LF / bare CR in Subject, FromName, ReplyTo, and comma-separated To/Cc lists (pkg/integrations/smtp/send_email.go:289-316)

O7_producer.where: pkg/workers/contexts/node_configuration_builder.go:244-271 (ResolveTemplateExpressions substitutes webhook payload values into config strings after Setup validation)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Reply-To header: validated with mail.ParseAddress only in Setup on the stored config; Execute writes the expression-resolved value verbatim and never passes it to Rcpt.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Setup already validates replyTo as an email address (pkg/integrations/smtp/send_email.go:203-207), so it looks protected.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: From display name: component fromName override (and integration-level fromName default) formatted raw into 'From:' header with no validation at Setup or Execute.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: From name is a sender override set by the workflow author / integration admin, not 'event data'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file; integration default comes from pkg/integrations/smtp/smtp.go:77-83 via NewClient pkg/integrations/smtp/client.go:145

O8_uncovered_routes.route: To/Cc parse errors are discarded at Execute (toAddrs, _ :=), so post-resolution address validation is lost; header injection here is currently stopped only incidentally by net/smtp Rcpt line validation.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Stdlib Rcpt rejects CR/LF, so the To/Cc header 'cannot' be injected.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: System mailer buildMultipartEmail writes From/Subject raw (second implementation).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only constant subject and admin-set From name reach it today.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second SMTPEmailService method (e.g. invitation or run-failure notification) whose subject includes a canvas/run/event name and calls sendEmail
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: EmailService (pkg/services/email.go:15-17) is a small interface clearly meant to grow, and sendEmail already takes an arbitrary subject parameter.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a custom-headers or 'In-Reply-To/References' (threading) option on smtp.sendEmail written as additional raw header lines
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Email threading for repeated alerts is a common feature request and would be added next to the existing Reply-To line.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an attachment filename written into a Content-Disposition part header
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Attachments are a natural extension of the existing multipart builder.

O9_family: CRLF / mail header injection (CWE-93) via expression-resolved workflow configuration

That Go net/smtp Client.Mail/Rcpt reject CR/LF (validateLine) is stdlib behaviour, not cited from this repo; it is why To/Cc/FromEmail look incidentally protected.

Whether net/mail.ParseAddress (used in Setup, pkg/integrations/smtp/send_email.go:198-207) accepts CR/LF inside comments or folding whitespace (a possible parser-differential how-type lever) was not checked.
Whether Setup runs on unresolved '{{ }}' config or skips expression fields was not checked; it decides how much the Setup validation protects Reply-To.
